claims.text: The hotel is in the Nişantaşı district of Istanbul.

findings.quote: Set in the cosmopolitan Nişantaşı district

claims.text: Its architecture is modernist and Art Deco influenced.

findings.quote: The modernist Art Deco influenced St. Regis Istanbul

claims.text: Maçka Park, with an outdoor playground, is directly across from the hotel.

findings.quote: An outdoor playground awaits directly across from the hotel at Maçka Park

claims.text: Taksim Square in the Beyoğlu District is a leisurely walk from the hotel.

findings.quote: A leisurely walk from our Istanbul hotel guides you to the Beyoğlu District and Taksim Square

claims.text: St. Regis Brasserie pairs Parisian elegance with Turkish and world flavors on its terrace, serving breakfast, dining, cocktails and afternoon tea.

findings.quote: St. Regis Brasserie pairs Parisian elegance with Turkish and world flavors on its inviting terrace, serving breakfast, refined dining, cocktails, and afternoon tea in Istanbul.

claims.text: Teas at St. Regis Brasserie are selected by a Tea Sommelier.

findings.quote: refined Teas at St. Regis Brasserie, selected by our Tea Sommelier

claims.text: A glazed wine cellar at the entrance holds international vintages, including Turkish wines.

findings.quote: an extensive glazed wine cellar positioned at the entrance houses an uncompromising selection of international vintages, including an excellent selection of Turkish wines.

claims.text: Iridium Spa is lit by candlelight and decorated with orchids and bonsai trees.

findings.quote: Step through the bronze doorway to Iridium Spa
it glows by candlelight and is adorned with orchids and bonsai trees

claims.text: The spa offers a Sultan Hammam ritual inspired by Ottoman bathing rituals.

findings.quote: Inspired by centuries of Ottoman bathing rituals, the Sultan Hammam at Iridium Spa is a ceremonial journey of purification and renewal.

claims.text: St. Regis Butler Service is available for all rooms and suites.

findings.quote: The signature St. Regis Butler Services at The St. Regis Istanbul are available for all our rooms and suites.

claims.text: The multilingual concierge team wears the Les Clefs d'Or keys and can arrange a two-hour private Bosphorus cruise aboard a luxury motor yacht.

findings.quote: our multilingual Concierge team is always on hand
proudly wearing the "Les Clefs d’Or," keys
can be used to access the Concierge’s following must-see destinations
this extraordinary two-hour private cruise aboard a luxury motor yacht

claims.text: Condé Nast Traveler describes the rooms as spacious, sleek and understated, with Bosphorus and Maçka Park views.

findings.quote: rooms are spacious, sleek, and considerably understated for a St. Regis property, allowing the beautiful Bosphorus and Maçka Park views to take the spotlight

claims.text: The Bentley Suite is a collaboration between St. Regis and Bentley Motors.

findings.quote: A collaboration between St. Regis and Bentley Motors, the award winning Bentley Suite is truly one of a kind.

claims.text: Iridium Spa has seven treatment rooms, including a VIP room with a private hammam, a couple's room and a Thai-themed room.

findings.quote: The spa's alluring atmosphere extends to seven treatment rooms, including a VIP room with private hammam, a couple’s room, and a Thai-themed room.

claims.text: Art displayed throughout the hotel includes works by international artists and pioneers of Turkish contemporary art.

findings.quote: The captivating art collection displayed throughout the hotel showcases masterpieces by international artists and pioneers of Turkish contemporary art.

claims.text: The hotel's signature Misty Mary is made with raki, turnip juice and red basil.

findings.quote: Misty Mary-The St. Regis Istanbul Bloody Mary
the Misty Mary uses traditional ingredients such as Rakı, turnip juice, and red basil

claims.text: Spago Istanbul by Wolfgang Puck serves California-inspired cuisine in a rooftop setting overlooking the Istanbul skyline.

findings.quote: Spago Istanbul by Wolfgang Puck, honored by the MICHELIN Guide for the third consecutive year, presents California-inspired cuisine and signature cocktails in an elegant rooftop setting overlooking Istanbul’s skyline.

claims.text: The hotel does not provide an airport shuttle service.

findings.quote: This hotel does not provide shuttle service.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the high-end positioning.
